reviews.decision_reason: This is the earliest boundary that can explain the behaviorally significant weakness: selected needs are treated as demanded using only supplied corpus fields such as need text, demand_score, source_id, and source_weight. The package omits observed jobs, pain, triggers, alternatives, consequences, and outcomes, so strict market-demand review cannot validate the selected demand records. Because downstream behavior faithfully consumes these handoffs, this upstream selection boundary is the top root-cause suspect rather than the downstream ranking or recommendation steps.

The normalized needs visible in the downstream input preserve the allowed record identifiers n06-r01 through n06-r08 and keep the fields needed by downstream consumers. No specific normalization defect is visible in the supplied package.
